model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the “effect” values for several language families across different model types. The horizontal axis displays language families, labeled IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic, progressing alphabetically, while the vertical axis represents “effect,” with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick labels at 0, 10, 20, and 30. For each language family, there is a grouped set of five bars, each representing a different model: mBERT-L<sub>2</sub> (blue), mBERT-R<sub>2</sub> (green), XLM-R<sub>2</sub> (red), XLM-B<sub>2</sub> (orange), and XLM-L<sub>2</sub> (teal).  Each bar is accompanied by a black error bar extending vertically above and below the bar’s top and bottom edges, signifying associated variance. The heights of the bars vary considerably across language families and models; for example, the mBERT-L<sub>2</sub> bar for IE-Baltic is approximately 6.3, while the XLM-B<sub>2</sub> bar for Uralic reaches roughly 2.4. There are no visually emphasized bars or annotations.
